Random obstacle gaps · speed rises gradually by 10% after every 10 clears, up to 500 px/s.

Input → Jump → Training

1 · Sense

One input neuron (N0) signals how close the next obstacle is.

2 · Jump

One output neuron (N1) triggers a jump when its spike rate passes the threshold. No command means no jump.

3 · Train

After a collision, a pair of N2–N5 fires for 0.3 seconds. Only the obstacle-to-jump connection can change.

Six simulated cells: one input, one output, four for training. The software selector favors patterns followed by longer trials; improvement is an experimental question.
